meta.description: Structured endgame drills for deliberate practice

drillTypes.name: Theoretical Position Mastery
drillTypes.description: Play out key theoretical positions vs engine until 100% score
method: Set up position from theoretical.json
Play vs engine (weak to strong)
Win 5 in a row at each level
Record time taken, aim for <30 seconds for basics

progression.mastery: 5 wins in a row at level 3

drillTypes.tracking: Log: position, level, result, time, errors

drillTypes.name: Advantage Conversion
drillTypes.description: Convert winning positions with decreasing advantage
method: Set up position: +1 to +3 pawns, various piece configs
Play vs engine (strong)
Goal: convert without letting advantage drop below +1.5
Analyze where advantage leaked
drillTypes.tracking: Log: start eval, end eval, moves to convert, critical moments

drillTypes.name: Difficult Defense
drillTypes.description: Hold drawn or slightly worse positions
method: Set up theoretically drawn but difficult positions
Play vs engine (strong, trying to win)
Goal: hold draw for 50 moves or reach known fortress
Identify defensive resources used

progression.expert: Engine says 0.00 but hard to hold

drillTypes.tracking: Log: position, held/draw/lost, key defensive moves, time used

drillTypes.name: Middlegame-to-Endgame Decisions
method: Set up middlegame positions from your games or model games
Decision point: trade queens? trade rooks? which minor piece?
Play out both choices vs engine
Compare results, understand why one better
scenarioTypes: Up a pawn: trade queens or keep?
Down a pawn: avoid trades or simplify to draw?
Better structure: which pieces to trade?
Worse structure: which pieces to keep?
Attack vs endgame: cash in or continue?
Opposite-color bishops: trade rooks or keep?
King safety: trade into ending or not?

progression.expert: Positions where engines disagree with humans

drillTypes.tracking: Log: position, decision, reasoning, engine eval both lines, outcome

drillTypes.name: Endgame Time Pressure Simulation
drillTypes.description: Practice endgame decisions with low time
method: Set clock: 30 seconds + 2 sec increment
Play endgame positions vs engine
Focus: premove forced lines, simplify, avoid blunders
Track: flag rate, blunder rate, draw/win rate
drillTypes.tracking: Log: time control, position type, result, flagged?, blunders?

drillTypes.name: Model Game Endgame Replay
drillTypes.description: Replay and analyze endgames from masters of your style
method: Select model game from your repertoire/style
Play through from move 30 to end
At each decision point: predict move, understand plan
Note: transitions, piece trades, king activation, pawn breaks
drillTypes.tracking: Log: game, key decisions, techniques learned, style notes

tuesday.focus: Rook endings week 1, Minor piece week 2, Queen week 3, K+P week 4

thursday.focus: Philidor/Vancura week 1, Opposite bishops week 2, Fortress week 3, Perpetual week 4

saturday.focus: Positions from your games this week

progressMetrics.theoreticalMastery: Percentage of 25 positions at mastery (5 wins level 3)
progressMetrics.conversionRate: Win% from +1/+2 pawn positions vs engine
progressMetrics.transitionAccuracy: % correct decisions in transition drills (engine verified)
progressMetrics.timePressureScore: Points per game in time pressure drills
progressMetrics.modelGameInsights: Number of techniques extracted per game
